appDescription: A virtual pet that lives in the car and reacts to real vehicle signals during trips and while parked.

function.name: CHAMA_MOOD
function.description: Tell how the in-car pet feels right now and the main reason, based on the current trip and vehicle condition.

topic.description: Which part of the pet's condition the user asks about.

function.name: CHAMA_DISTANCE
function.description: Tell how far the in-car pet has traveled with the user and how far remains to the current destination.

scope.description: Which distance the user asks about.

function.name: CHAMA_THANKS
function.description: Deliver the user's kind words to the in-car pet and return its short reply.

kind.description: Type of kind words the user said to the pet.
